chunks: (The Pharaoh) said: "Then bring it, if you speak the truth."
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh say to Musa when challenged to prove his prophethood?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Pharaoh issues a defiant challenge to Prophet Musa (AS) to produce a tangible miracle as proof of his divine mission, highlighting the political and spiritual tension between the oppressor and the prophet. This rhetorical challenge underscores the theme of divine authority versus earthly power, a central motif in the narrative of Musa's confrontation with Fir'awn. The phrase 'if you are of the truthful' serves as a test of Musa's sincerity and the authenticity of his message, inviting the court of Egypt to witness the miracle.
